# points of interest

[← back to index](../index.md)

### `When` I click an empty part of the page outside the artwork

clicks empty space in the letterbox beside the artwork

- **Prereq:** a point is open on a landscape screen
- **Uses:** page
- **Source:** `tests/steps/points-of-interest.steps.ts:30`

### `When` I tab to the {string} point

presses Tab, up to 40 times, until the point's hotspot has keyboard focus, and fails if it never does

- **Prereq:** the room is showing with no point open
- **Uses:** page
- **Source:** `tests/steps/points-of-interest.steps.ts:40`

### `Then` the reading panel body is still typing

waits until the visible body has started typing but has not finished: some text is showing, and it is a strict part of the full text

- **Prereq:** a point with a body has just opened
- **Uses:** page
- **Source:** `tests/steps/points-of-interest.steps.ts:12`
